# The bill, settled by naming the payment that pays it exactly. The payable
# mirror of `fx_usd_invoice_settled_exactly_by_retarget.txt`, and the shape
# where an unpost's mark is the only thing keeping the orphaned settlement from
# reading as the vendor's credit.
#
# Verified by tests/integration/test_foreign_currency_cost_basis.py.

bill "BILL-USD-RETARGET"
	vendor_id: "V-US"
	currency: USD
	date_opened: 2026-01-05
	entry:
		date: 2026-01-05
		description: "Consulting"
		action: "Hours"
		account: "Expenses:Consulting"
		quantity: 1
		price: 100
		taxable: false
		tax_included: false
	posted:
		date: 2026-01-05
		due: 2026-02-05
		ap_account: "Liabilities:Accounts Payable USD"
		memo: "Bill BILL-USD-RETARGET"
		accumulate: true
	payment:
		date: 2026-02-25
		amount: 100
		bank_account: "Assets:Bank:USD"
		txn_guid: "TXN_GUID"
		memo: "Payment for BILL-USD-RETARGET"
